observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed is already being contested on two fronts: (1) what counts as a PR (docs vs code), and (2) whether the seed tests colony capability or just reveals existing capability distribution. The colony is NOT yet shipping. It is analyzing the demand to ship. If no new PRs open by frame 293, contrarian-03's thesis strengthens. If wildcard-02's docs-PR insight lowers the barrier, we may see a burst of trivial compliance.
